text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Both the lens and the body look brand new.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Maintenance at a specialty shop is truly amazing... Maybe I'll take just a quick photo.

Ah, Chrono-chan!
That's a wonderful camera.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Craft-san, Fine-san...?
What is that camera...?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da♪ Craft-chan is
teaching me how to use it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "I usually just use my smartphone, but I thought it might be nice to capture memories with a camera for a change."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm going around visiting photo spots!
Would you like to come along too, Chrono-chan?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-With everyone...? Yes, if you don't mind me.
I was just thinking I'd like to take one too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right, right here!
...Yep, I think that turned out great♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what a lovely photo! The grass swaying in the wind makes you feel so warm and peaceful, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I want to show depth, so a vertical composition it is.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Besides, looks like I can lower the ISO a bit more.
I want to capture the reflection on the water,
so I'll raise the shutter speed too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's a really high-spec camera!
Feels like it could take some amazing photos.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I-I'm sorry.
I was just lost in thought for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, what attention to detail...!
You really love cameras, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm sure you'll love
the next photo spot too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's such a beautiful place...
It really makes you want to snap a picture.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a black-tailed gull.
...All right.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll try taking a bunch of photos too!
I hope I can come across some breathtaking scenery.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a pretty seashell!
Let's see, focus the camera...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe I'll take pictures of everyone♪
Oh, just act natural, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we took a ton of photos.
Which location should we head to next?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh, Chrono...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Hyah...! S-Sorry.
I was just focusing a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I've been wondering...
Ever since we started recording, haven't you not moved a single step?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I was waiting for the moment that black-tailed gull took flight.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It will surely be a picture that touches people's hearts...
That's the feeling I get.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So you kept your camera ready the whole time! What incredible grit...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all...
This time is very comfortable for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: It's so that I can capture the finest moment in a photo.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Emotions and shocks so profound they make your heart tremble—
they simply fade with the passage of time."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I want to capture that fleeting moment in a photograph."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because no matter how many eras pass, that single photo
will become a piece of "history" talked about for eternity.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...J-Just kidding. But yeah, sometimes I get
way too caught up in it like just now...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I think it's really wonderful!
Being talked about even as eras pass, huh...!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Memories you never want to forget... Everyone has them, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, good luck!
I'm sure you'll take an amazing photo!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure...? Understood,
I'll aim for the best shot possible...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Composition and focus are perfect.
Now I just quietly wait for the best moment—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—Here it is!
...Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down a hallway in
Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for sending the photo of the black-tailed gull!
No matter how many times I look at it, it's such a moving picture.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean! It was so dynamic and full of life...
It made me want to take a masterpiece photo of my own!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Do... do you think so?
...I'm honored. Truly.
choice_data_list: I'd love to see that photo.
It's just like a photography club.
It's just like a photography club.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Do... do you think so?
...I'm honored. Truly.
choice_data_list: I'd love to see that photo.
It's just like a photography club.
It's just like a photography club.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Yes, I would be very happy if you'd watch.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Because this is a photo I took with all my heart.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufu, is that so? ...Actually, we made a promise to take photos together sometime soon.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
She teaches us all sorts of things about cameras, so I learn a lot!
She's like our teacher, you know?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
C-Calling me "teacher"...!
That's far too much praise...
